title: Unprotected Oracle Price Setter — Anyone Can Manipulate Any Market Price
impact: An attacker sets any collateral price to `0` (or an arbitrary value). With price = 0, every borrower's collateral value computes to 0 → `getHypotheticalAccountLiquidity` reports infinite shortfall → **all positions become instantly liquidatable**, or alternatively the market is frozen (no borrows/mints pass liquidity checks). Conversely, an attacker can set a price to an inflated value to borrow against worthless collateral, draining all underlying liquidity from every market sharing that oracle. Direct, permissionless, irreversible-in-practice fund loss.
